title: Tidywells: open-source tools and open monthly dataset for Canadian oil and gas production
description: Python loaders for public Petrinex (Alberta, Saskatchewan) and BC Energy Regulator files, a bounded Arps decline-curve fit, and an open monthly province-level production dataset with a verified analysis site at https://tidywells.com. Not affiliated with any regulator; for illustration only, not for reserves reporting or investment decisions.
